description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the ScreenPermissionDao component in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, performs assertions on permissions retrieval, and verifies permission properties.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the ScreenPermissionDao, testing permission fetching and verification logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the testing environment by loading fixture data and initializing the DAO object.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermission
methods.description: Runs multiple assertions to verify permissions are correctly fetched and role-based permissions are correctly identified.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Helper method to assert that a permission object has the expected read, create, update, and delete rights.
